import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, f, cap, cost, rev;
        Edge(int to, int f, int cap, int cost, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.f = f;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class MCF {
        int n;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        int[] u, v, prio, curflow, prevedge, prevnode, pot;

        MCF(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            u = new int[n];
            v = new int[n];
            prio = new int[n];
            curflow = new int[n];
            prevedge = new int[n];
            prevnode = new int[n];
            pot = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
            adj.get(s).add(new Edge(t, 0, cap, cost, adj.get(t).size()));
            adj.get(t).add(new Edge(s, 0, 0, -cost, adj.get(s).size() - 1));
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            int flowCost = 0;
            final int INF = (int)1e9;
            PriorityQueue<Long> q = new PriorityQueue<>();
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(prio, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                prio[s] = 0;
                curflow[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                q.clear();
                q.offer(((long)prio[s] << 32) + s);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    long cur = q.poll();
                    int d = (int)(cur >> 32);
                    int uNode = (int)(cur & 0xFFFFFFFFL);
                    if (d != prio[uNode]) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(uNode).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = adj.get(uNode).get(i);
                        int vNode = e.to;
                        if (e.cap <= e.f) continue;
                        int nprio = prio[uNode] + e.cost + pot[uNode] - pot[vNode];
                        if (prio[vNode] > nprio) {
                            prio[vNode] = nprio;
                            q.offer(((long)nprio << 32) + vNode);
                            prevnode[vNode] = uNode;
                            prevedge[vNode] = i;
                            curflow[vNode] = Math.min(curflow[uNode], e.cap - e.f);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (prio[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    pot[i] += prio[i];
                }
                int df = Math.min(curflow[t], INF - flow);
                flow += df;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                    Edge e = adj.get(prevnode[v]).get(prevedge[v]);
                    e.f += df;
                    adj.get(v).get(e.rev).f -= df;
                    flowCost += df * e.cost;
                }
            }
            return new Pair<>(flow, flowCost);
        }
    }

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        public final U first;
        public final V second;
        public Pair(U first, V second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int totalNodes = 6 + 107 * n;
        MCF network = new MCF(totalNodes);

        for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            network.addEdge(0, 1 + x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            y--;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 104; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= 50; j++) {
                    network.addEdge(1 + i * n + x, 1 + (i + 1) * n + y, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    network.addEdge(1 + i * n + y, 1 + (i + 1) * n + x, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                network.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, 51, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
            network.addEdge(1 + i * n, 1 + 105 * n, 51, 0);
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> result = network.minCostFlow(0, 1 + 105 * n);
        System.out.println(result.second);
        sc.close();
    }
}
